context: The Race IndyCar Podcast host JR Hildebrand scored his best qualifying result since 2017 in 17th, just behind Simon Pagenaud who marked a bittersweet day for the reigning winners Meyer Shank Racing. The 2021 winner Helio Castroneves will start 27th after bailing out of his first run due to the tricky conditions and a poor car balance. He won from eighth on the grid last year.
